decision: Wave47 produced no scientific evidence because its evaluation-only command referenced the nonexistent wave46 run-root best.pt; the completed replay-trained checkpoint is actually model/best.pt. Re-run only the unchanged representation audit and target-free closed-loop evaluation against that exact checkpoint. Promote replay beyond seed 0 only if first-step true advantage remains positive, mean selected true advantage over decisions 2-4 and full normalized edit-distance improvement both exceed the information-matched expert-only hard-latent parent, and representation health does not collapse. Otherwise reject expert-state coverage as the primary explanation and stop scaling the present GAR planner. All deployable proposal generation and GAR selection remain target-free; target access is restricted to separately labelled evaluation metrics and any explicitly candidate-privileged diagnostic.

jobs.purpose: Recover the missing representation audit and target-free closed-loop evaluation using the actual completed wave46 checkpoint path.
